summary: Climber on Quandary Peak's West Ridge fell ~30 ft then tumbled ~200 ft over sharp rock into a couloir; other hikers heard him calling for help; deputies and rescue group members shuttled partway by Flight for Life; National Guard Black Hawk hoisted him out to St. Anthony Summit Hospital with a broken leg and head injury
responding_agency: Summit County Rescue Group, Summit County Sheriff's Office, Flight for Life, CO Army National Guard
notes: Occured three days after the July 15 east-ridge rescue in the same TNS article
